description: Searches Livuma's live Bali rental and property-sale inventory with the same results, filters and prices as the livuma.com search page. Returns { items, page, pageSize, total, hasMore, filteredAfterPaging }. Each item has the canonical url, the primary photo, the price for this search (the stay total when dates are given, otherwise the per-period rate), the host's rates and minimum stays, amenities, rating, coordinates and isBookable. `total` is the number of database matches. When `filteredAfterPaging` is true, the exact per-stay price was applied after paging, so a page can hold fewer items than pageSize while `hasMore` is still true. One area is searched per request. Search results are not a booking quote: availability, the applicable rate and the exact price are confirmed only by the availability check for specific dates.

area.description: One area name, e.g. "Canggu". Free text, geocoded server-side.

areaRadiusKm.description: Search radius in km around the area or the coordinates (default 10, max 20).

checkOutDate.description: Check-out date, yyyy-MM-dd. Omit for open_ended and yearly.

excludeIds.description: Listing GUIDs to exclude, e.g. results already shown to the user.

includeInsights.description: Include AI-extracted photo and description insights. Off by default — they are large.

latitude.description: Center latitude for coordinate-based location filtering (use with longitude; alternative to area).

longitude.description: Center longitude for coordinate-based location filtering (use with latitude).

maxPrice.description: Budget in `currency`, compared against the price shown for this search: the stay TOTAL when check-in and check-out are given, otherwise the monthly rate (yearly in yearly mode) or the asking price for sales.

minPrice.description: Minimum budget in `currency`, same unit rules as maxPrice.

ownershipType.description: Ownership type for sales, e.g. "Freehold". Not used for rentals.

rentalMode.description: How a rental stay is priced: "dates" (default — give checkInDate + checkOutDate, or neither to browse monthly rates), "open_ended" (checkInDate only, monthly rate, no end date), "yearly" (checkInDate only, fixed 12-month term).
